title: Blockchain from Scratch
subtitle: A blockchain you can take apart
description: Nine hands-on chapters, from hashing to a peer-to-peer network. The same Rust code powers interactive WebAssembly demonstrations in your browser.
longDescription: A learning project that builds a blockchain in Rust, one executable chapter at a time: hashes, blocks, mining, signatures, a mempool, networking, consensus and file proofs. Browser demonstrations compile the same Rust core to WebAssembly; Docker Compose runs a three-node network.
features: Nine chapters with runnable examples and exercises
Interactive hashing, mining and tampering demonstrations
Shared Rust core compiled to WebAssembly
Three-node Docker network and a file-proof application
